metadata.description: Fine-tune FLUX 3 Image Klein with your own images to teach it a subject, a product or a style.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable safety checks for training media. Disabling requires account permission.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

images_data_url.description: URL to a .zip archive of training images (PNG/JPG/JPEG/WebP). An image named ROOT.EXT pairs with an optional caption file ROOT.txt; images without one use `trigger_phrase` as their caption.
images_data_url.title: Images Data Url

learning_rate.description: Learning rate of the LoRA parameters.
learning_rate.title: Learning Rate

resolution.description: Training resolution. Images keep their aspect ratio and are resized to about resolution x resolution pixels.
resolution.title: Resolution

trigger_phrase.description: Caption for every image that ships no caption file. Required when any image lacks one.
trigger_phrase.title: Trigger Phrase

lora_file.description: URL to the trained LoRA weights.

info.description: Train a LoRA on the FLUX 3 Image Klein base model from a .zip of images. Each image ROOT.png/jpg/jpeg/webp can ship a caption ROOT.txt; images without one use trigger_phrase. Options: steps 100-10000 (default 1000), learning_rate (default 1e-4), resolution 512, 768 or 1024 (default 1024, aspect ratio kept). Returns lora_file (safetensors) and config_file. Use the LoRA on FLUX 3 Klein LoRA endpoints (base recommended). Billed per training step, minimum 100 steps.
info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/flux-3-image-klein-trainer

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).
